Diabetes App -Blood Sugar Log allows you to easily record data every day, including blood glucose tracking, blood pressure tracking, weight tracking and diet tracking, to help users manage their weight, blood pressure and blood glucose, there are also different tabs in the app, including wake up & fasting, before breakfast, after breakfast, and other 10 kinds of tabs, which can help users to record data in different time periods and states of the body. and body data at different times and in different states.

At the same time, we will summarize the data that the user fills in every day, so that it is easy for the user and his medical personnel to view,whether you have diabetes or prediabetes, this app makes it easy to track your blood glucose levels. diabetes App -Blood Sugar Log also offers an estimated HbA1C calculator to help keep you on track in between lab measurements.

In addition to tracking your blood glucose, this app makes it easy to track your blood pressure levels, and we also calculate the MAP for you to help keep you on track in between lab measurements.

There are hundreds of foods on the glycemic index in the app, and we will be offering more diabetic meal plans in the future.

Most importantly, users can set up measurement and medication reminders in the APP to remind them to take measurements or medications according to their needs, and we also provide medication inventory management, so that we can remind users to replenish their medication inventory if they are running low.


The default unit of blood glucose is mg/dL, you can switch to mmol/L in the settings.


Attention:
Diabetes App -Blood Sugar Log is only a blood glucose tracking app, the HbA1C and MAP provided in the app are approximate values calculated based on the average of the data filled in by the user, this data can only help you to understand your own blood glucose and blood pressure levels, and can not replace the results of the laboratory.
